resource_alias.title: List Resources
resource_alias.description: Use this to list tables available to fetch.

batch_size.title: Maximum concurrent requests
batch_size.description: The maximum number of requests to process at a time.

sync_type.title: Sync method
sync_type.description: Full sync will fetch all data from the source table. Incremental sync will fetch only data that has changed since the last run.

enum_titles: No pagination (fetch all data at once)

delta_lookback_days.title: Delta lookback (days)
delta_lookback_days.description: Only for incremental sync. Shifts the stored delta pointer back by the given number of days, so each run re-fetches an overlapping window (e.g. 10 = fetch everything changed since 10 days before the last pointer). Works only for timestamp based delta pointers (YYYYMMDD or YYYYMMDDHHMMSS).

output_table_name.title: Storage Table Name (Optional)
output_table_name.description: Name of the table stored in Storage. Defaults to resource name.

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: If Full load is used, the destination table will be overwritten every run. If incremental load is used, data will be upserted into the destination table. Tables with a primary key will have rows updated, tables without a primary key will have rows appended.
